body: Can't reproduce it on macOS. Please check if https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109046 fixes it.

Also, please check output of following commands:
```
dbus-send --dest=org.a11y.Bus --print-reply /org/a11y/bus org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:org.a11y.Status string:IsEnabled
```

```
dbus-send --dest=org.a11y.Bus --print-reply /org/a11y/bus org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:org.a11y.Status string:ScreenReaderEnabled
```

It still crashes after applying #109046.

```console
$ dbus-send --dest=org.a11y.Bus --print-reply /org/a11y/bus org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:org.a11y.Status string:IsEnabled
method return time=1755523080.250307 sender=:1.10 -> destination=:1.526 serial=37157 reply_serial=2
   variant       boolean true

$ dbus-send --dest=org.a11y.Bus --print-reply /org/a11y/bus org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get string:org.a11y.Status string:ScreenReaderEnabled
method return time=1755523085.340728 sender=:1.10 -> destination=:1.527 serial=37158 reply_serial=2
   variant       boolean false
```
Not reproducible on Windows and macOS, and seems to be crash in the AccessKit background thread, so likely upstream issue.
